Projects as modelling problems

Each project is described by its question, the system, the model structure and what came out of it.

Ecology and evolution

The primary domain. Eco-evolutionary models of community assembly, trait evolution and regime shifts, from doctoral research to MSc work.

Ecology & evolution

The evolutionary consequences of isolation

How does restricted immigration change the ecological and evolutionary dynamics of a community?

Ongoing2025 – presentEco-evolutionary modelling · Stochastic simulation · Community assembly

Ecology & evolution

Trait evolution in mutualistic interaction networks

How do trait distributions, mutualistic interactions, population dynamics and evolution shape one another?

Completed2026Eco-evolutionary modelling · Trait-based population dynamics · Interaction networks

Ecology & evolution

Regime shifts in Mediterranean fish and invertebrate communities

Do climate and fishing push Mediterranean communities through abrupt, discontinuous transitions?

Completed2024Catastrophe theory · Stochastic modelling · Regime-shift detection

Ecology & evolution

Functional diversity of Mediterranean fish communities

How much of a community's functional trait space is occupied, and how does that change under global change?

Completed2021 – 2023n-dimensional hypervolumes · Functional diversity · Phylogenetic inference

Sustainability and social systems

Systems reasoning applied to organisations, institutions and policy.

Sustainability & social systems

Organisations, institutions and sustainability as a systems problem

What determines whether organisations commit to sustainable development and circular-economy principles?

Published2023 – presentSystems frameworks · Institutional analysis · Survey analysis

Marine systems and monitoring

Earlier empirical work: species monitoring and citizen science in the eastern Mediterranean.

Marine systems & monitoring

Tracking marine invasions with citizen science

Can records from divers, fishers and the public reliably track the spread of non-indigenous species?

Published2018 – 2023Citizen-science data · Species monitoring · Taxonomy and identification
